name: training-record
title: Student training record
for_each: select id,code from students where status<>'withdrawn' order by code

sections.title: Syllabus
sections.note: Every lesson in the course and where the student stands on it.
sections.sql: select lesson,title,kind,attempts,case when competent then 'competent' when attempts>0 then 'in progress' else '' end state,competent_on from v_lesson_progress where student_id=$1 order by seq

sections.title: Flights and debriefs
sections.sql: select flown_on,lesson,kind,aircraft,instructor,hours,landings,outcome,grade,debrief from v_flights where student_id=$1 order by flown_on,code

sections.title: Theory exams
sections.sql: select subject,sat_on,score,pass_mark from exams where student_id=$1 order by sat_on

sections.title: Before the flight test
sections.note: Check the record against the syllabus in your exposition before it is signed.
sections.sql: select coalesce(nullif(missing,''),'Nothing outstanding') still_to_do from v_test_ready t join students s on s.code=t.student where s.id=$1

name: statement-of-account
title: Statement of account
for_each: select s.id,s.code from students s where s.status<>'withdrawn' and exists (select 1 from flights f where f.student_id=s.id) order by s.code

sections.title: Account
sections.sql: select s.code,s.name,s.sponsor bill_to,b.charged,b.paid,b.balance from students s join v_balances b on b.student_id=s.id where s.id=$1

sections.title: Flying charged
sections.sql: select flown_on,coalesce(lesson,kind) item,aircraft,instructor,hours,charge from v_flights where student_id=$1 order by flown_on,code

sections.title: Payments received
sections.sql: select paid_on,ref,amount from payments where student_id=$1 order by paid_on

name: aircraft-status
title: Aircraft status sheet
for_each: select id,code from aircraft where kind<>'simulator' order by code

sections.title: Defects not cleared
sections.sql: select code,raised_on,description,deferred,due_on from defects where aircraft_id=$1 and cleared_on is null order by raised_on

sections.title: Booked in the next 7 days
sections.sql: select b.code,b.booked_on,b.starts,b.ends,b.kind,s.code student from bookings b join students s on s.id=b.student_id where b.aircraft_id=$1 and b.status='booked' and b.booked_on between current_date and current_date+7 order by b.booked_on,b.starts
